description: Trigger evals for journey-map: it fires when a user flow across several documented screens needs one journey doc, while screen-spec, pattern-doc, component-spec and screen-spec-fleet handle a single screen, a reusable UX solution, one component, and many screens in parallel.

should_trigger: Map the onboarding journey for a new client: sign up, verify email, set a PIN, land on home. I have the four screen docs ready.
document how a controller goes from the alerts list to approving a request, across screens 12, 13, 14 and 19. Include what happens on a network error or timeout.
write up the password reset flow end to end, with the happy path, validation failures, and what VoiceOver users hear between screens
I need a flow diagram and critical states for the checkout journey. Screens are in docs/research/screens, persona is a first-time buyer.
journey doc for the invite-a-teammate flow please

should_not_trigger.prompt: Document just the payment confirmation screen from its Figma frame: layout, spacing, copy and error states.
We show empty states on a dozen screens with the same illustration, headline and button. Write down the reusable approach so every team does it the same way.
Spec the bottom sheet component from Figma: anatomy, variants, states, motion and API.
Here are 8 Figma frames for the account area. Produce one document per screen, all at once, and update the screen map.
The signup flow is built and served at localhost:3000. Walk its three pages and check keyboard focus, console errors and layout overflow at a small phone width.
